lines.zh: 我摆一下尾，漂出半尺。
lines.en: One tail wiggle drifts me half a foot.

lines.zh: 身子软，水一推我就走。
lines.en: My body is soft; any current moves me.

lines.zh: 我贴着沟壁滑，像一片果冻。
lines.en: I slide along the wall like a piece of jelly.

lines.zh: 小小的我，在冷水里打转。
lines.en: Tiny me, spinning through the cold water.

lines.zh: 我的肚皮吸住石头，停一下。
lines.en: My belly grips the stone for a moment.

lines.zh: 三条一起游，影子乱成一团。
lines.en: Three of us swim; our shadows tangle.

lines.zh: 没有鳞，我游起来更轻。
lines.en: No scales, so I swim lighter.

lines.zh: 我绕开大石头，从缝里钻。
lines.en: I go around the big rock through a gap.

lines.zh: 尾鳍太小，我只能慢慢挪。
lines.en: My tail fin is tiny; I can only creep.

lines.zh: 上面有光，我不敢去。
lines.en: There is light up there; I will not go.

lines.zh: 我一窜，窜不到一掌远。
lines.en: I dart, and cover less than a palm.

lines.zh: 粉白的身子在水里几乎透明。
lines.en: My pale pink body is nearly clear in water.

lines.zh: 我跟着水流走，不费力气。
lines.en: I ride the current; it costs no effort.

lines.zh: 沟底的沙太软，我陷进去一点。
lines.en: The trench sand is soft; I sink a little.

lines.zh: 我把自己挤进石缝，只露尾巴。
lines.en: I squeeze into a rock crevice with only my tail out.

lines.zh: 冷流一冲，我就顺势翻个身。
lines.en: A cold current hits and I roll with it.

lines.zh: 沟底太窄，我们一条一条过。
lines.en: The trench floor is too narrow; we pass one at a time.

lines.zh: 我们挤成一团淡粉的雾。
lines.en: We crowd together like a pale pink mist.

lines.zh: 我趴在一块石头上，慢慢呼吸。
lines.en: I rest on a stone, breathing slowly.

lines.zh: 周围很黑，我眼睛又小。
lines.en: It is dark around me, and my eyes are small.

lines.zh: 一点碎屑飘过，我张嘴试试。
lines.en: A bit of debris drifts by; I try my mouth.

lines.zh: 我只有一点生命，得小心。
lines.en: I have a single point of life; I must be careful.

lines.zh: 同伴贴在旁边，我们一起等。
lines.en: A companion clings nearby; we wait together.

lines.zh: 大影子过去，我立刻不动。
lines.en: A big shadow passes; I go completely still.

lines.zh: 水里没有什么味道，我发呆。
lines.en: The water tastes of nothing; I zone out.

lines.zh: 我的皮薄得能看见影子。
lines.en: My skin is thin enough to show shadows.

lines.zh: 安静久了，我以为自己也是石头。
lines.en: Still so long, I think I am stone too.

lines.zh: 深沟里的时间，慢得像冻住。
lines.en: Time in the deep trench crawls like ice.

lines.zh: 我缩成一粒，谁也看不见我。
lines.en: I shrink to a speck where no one sees me.

lines.zh: 吸盘贴着石面，很稳。
lines.en: My suction disc holds the stone firmly.

lines.zh: 有东西在动，我先装死。
lines.en: Something moves; I play dead first.

lines.zh: 等危险过去，我再伸头。
lines.en: When the danger passes, I poke my head out.

lines.zh: 你这么大，我该装成石头。
lines.en: You are huge; I should pretend to be stone.

lines.zh: 仰头看你太久，我的鳃发酸。
lines.en: Looking up so long makes my gills ache.

lines.zh: 你的灯照得我全身发白。
lines.en: Your lamp turns me white all over.

lines.zh: 我只是条小鱼，别踩我。
lines.en: I am only a small fish; do not step on me.

lines.zh: 我从你脚边溜过去。
lines.en: I slip past the edge of your foot.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了整块石头。
lines.en: Your shadow covers the entire stone.

lines.zh: 我眼睛小，可我看得见你。
lines.en: My eyes are small, but I see you.

lines.zh: 你停着，我就当自己没长眼睛。
lines.en: You stay put, and I pretend to have no eyes.

lines.zh: 深沟里第一次来了这么大的客人。
lines.en: This deep trench has never had such a big guest.

lines.zh: 你要是伸手，我就钻缝。
lines.en: If you reach out, I squeeze into a crack.

lines.zh: 一点生命，挨一下就少一点。
lines.en: One point of life; one hit takes it.

lines.zh: 一击把我掀得肚皮朝天。
lines.en: One blow turns my belly to the sky.

lines.zh: 疼，但我连喊都喊不大。
lines.en: It hurts, but I cannot even cry loudly.

lines.zh: 我的身体被拍在石头上。
lines.en: My body is slapped against the stone.

lines.zh: 血只有一点点，很快就散了。
lines.en: So little blood; it disperses at once.

lines.zh: 我摊平了不动，装成一片皮。
lines.en: I spread flat and play a strip of skin.

lines.zh: 同伴跑了，我还躺着。
lines.en: My companions fled; I am still lying here.

lines.zh: 软的皮，挡不住任何东西。
lines.en: Soft skin stops nothing at all.

lines.zh: 这一下差点要了我全部。
lines.en: That nearly took all of me.

lines.zh: 我还能动，就还能活。
lines.en: If I can still move, I can still live.

lines.zh: 那点碎屑，正好一口。
lines.en: That little scrap is exactly one mouthful.

lines.zh: 鱼排太大，我只咬得下一角。
lines.en: The fillet is huge; I can only nip a corner.

lines.zh: 香味来了，我的身体先动。
lines.en: The scent arrives; my body moves first.

lines.zh: 我游过去，又怕是个陷阱。
lines.en: I swim over, then fear it is a trap.

lines.zh: 你手一低，我就敢靠近。
lines.en: Lower your hand and I dare come near.

lines.zh: 我嘴很小，吃不了多少。
lines.en: My mouth is tiny; I eat very little.

lines.zh: 这点东西够我高兴一天。
lines.en: This little bit makes my whole day.

lines.zh: 别晃那块肉，我盯不稳。
lines.en: Do not wave that flesh; I cannot keep track.

lines.zh: 我咬一口就跑，习惯了。
lines.en: Nip and run; I am used to it.

lines.zh: 吃饱了，我就回石头下面。
lines.en: Fed, I go back under the stone.

lines.zh: 你一碰，我差点被压扁。
lines.en: One touch nearly flattens me.

lines.zh: 我太软，撞一下就变形。
lines.en: I am so soft a bump reshapes me.

lines.zh: 被推开了，我转了三圈。
lines.en: Shoved aside, I spin three times.

lines.zh: 别捏，我没有骨头护着。
lines.en: Do not squeeze; I have no bones to protect me.

lines.zh: 我从你指缝里滑出去。
lines.en: I slip out between your fingers.

lines.zh: 这一下不疼，就是很晕。
lines.en: It does not hurt; I am just dizzy.

lines.zh: 我贴在石头上才停下来。
lines.en: I only stop once I hit the stone.

lines.zh: 软的坏处，就是挡不住。
lines.en: The trouble with being soft is I block nothing.

lines.zh: 同伴也被撞散了。
lines.en: My companions got scattered by the bump too.

lines.zh: 再碰一下，我就成碎片。
lines.en: One more bump and I am pieces.

lines.zh: 旁边那条也是狮子鱼。
lines.en: That one beside me is a snailfish too.

lines.zh: 我们头挨着头，谁都不躲。
lines.en: We press heads together and neither hides.

lines.zh: 这么小的鱼，也要成对。
lines.en: Even a fish this small pairs up.

lines.zh: 三条一起转，分不清谁是谁。
lines.en: Three of us circle; no telling who is who.

lines.zh: 冷水里，我们把卵藏进石缝。
lines.en: In cold water we hide our eggs in the crevice.

lines.zh: 我贴着你，像贴在石头上。
lines.en: I cling to you as I cling to stone.

lines.zh: 慢一点，我的尾鳍只有指甲大。
lines.en: Slow down; my tail fin is the size of a nail.

lines.zh: 成对之后，我们还是食物。
lines.en: Paired or not, we are still food.

lines.zh: 这段沟够安静，可以留下后代。
lines.en: This trench is quiet enough to leave young.

lines.zh: 完事了，我们各自贴回石头。
lines.en: Done, we each cling back to a stone.

lines.zh: 我顶着那粒东西滚了两下。
lines.en: I nudge the little thing and it rolls twice.

lines.zh: 太大的我搬不动，只能看着。
lines.en: Too big to move; I can only watch.

lines.zh: 一小块鱼排，够我含很久。
lines.en: A scrap of fillet I can hold a long while.

lines.zh: 我叼着它钻进石缝，藏严实。
lines.en: I carry it into the crevice and stow it well.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西，多半砸不到我。
lines.en: Falling things mostly miss me.

lines.zh: 我咬了一下，发现是沙子。
lines.en: I bite down and find it is sand.

lines.zh: 我的嘴小，捡东西也小。
lines.en: Small mouth, small things to pick up.

lines.zh: 有吃的就藏，这是本能。
lines.en: Hide food when found; pure instinct.

lines.zh: 同伴来抢，我就让给它。
lines.en: A companion grabs it; I let it have it.

lines.zh: 反正我吃一点就饱。
lines.en: Anyway, a single bite fills me up.

lines.zh: 那点碎肉比我还小，归我。
lines.en: That scrap of flesh is smaller than me; mine.

lines.zh: 我盯着一只小虫，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I eye a tiny creature and creep closer.

lines.zh: 太大的东西，我连想都不想。
lines.en: Anything too big I do not even consider.

lines.zh: 它没发现我，这很少见。
lines.en: It has not noticed me; that is rare.

lines.zh: 我选最软的那一块。
lines.en: I pick the softest piece.

lines.zh: 吃一口就够，我不贪。
lines.en: One bite is enough; I am not greedy.

lines.zh: 有鲨鱼的味道，我先放弃。
lines.en: There is shark scent; I give it up.

lines.zh: 小目标，风险也小。
lines.en: Small target, small risk.

lines.zh: 我贴着沟底接近，不激起沙。
lines.en: I approach along the floor without stirring sand.

lines.zh: 抢到了就躲回石头下。
lines.en: Once I get it, I hide under the stone.

lines.zh: 我一点点靠近，几乎没动。
lines.en: I close in bit by bit, barely moving.

lines.zh: 它的影子比我的身子大。
lines.en: Its shadow is bigger than my whole body.

lines.zh: 再近一寸，我就咬。
lines.en: One inch closer and I bite.

lines.zh: 我把吸盘松开，慢慢滑。
lines.en: I release my suction disc and glide.

lines.zh: 它一转身，我就贴住石头。
lines.en: It turns; I press against the stone.

lines.zh: 我心跳得太快，水都在抖。
lines.en: My heart races so hard the water trembles.

lines.zh: 眼睛小，只能靠水流动静。
lines.en: Small eyes; I rely on the water's motion.

lines.zh: 我离它只剩一尾的距离。
lines.en: Only a tail's length between us now.

lines.zh: 上面有个大影子，我僵住了。
lines.en: A big shadow above; I freeze.

lines.zh: 拼一把，反正我只有一点生命。
lines.en: One go at it; I have only one point anyway.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，你大概没感觉。
lines.en: I bite you; you probably feel nothing.

lines.zh: 牙齿细得像沙，咬不穿皮。
lines.en: My teeth are like sand; they pierce nothing.

lines.zh: 我用尽力气，也只留个白印。
lines.en: All my strength leaves a pale mark only.

lines.zh: 撞你一下，我弹回来了。
lines.en: I bump you and bounce right back.

lines.zh: 这不是攻击，是求你别吃我。
lines.en: This is not an attack; it is please do not eat me.

lines.zh: 我咬完立刻逃，逃得很快。
lines.en: I bite, then flee, and flee fast.

lines.zh: 我的力气，连沙子都推不动。
lines.en: My strength cannot even push sand.

lines.zh: 你一动，我就被甩开了。
lines.en: You move, and I am thrown off.

lines.zh: 一点生命，还敢咬你。
lines.en: One point of life, and still I bite you.

lines.zh: 咬完我后悔了，快跑。
lines.en: I regret biting at once; run.

lines.zh: 我们三条一起落在沟底。
lines.en: The three of us land on the trench floor together.

lines.zh: 我出生时，身子还是透明的。
lines.en: When I am born, my body is still clear.

lines.zh: 这条沟随便哪一段都能住。
lines.en: Any stretch of this trench will house me.

lines.zh: 一点生命，从第一口呼吸开始。
lines.en: One point of life, starting with the first breath.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，暖和些。
lines.en: We huddle together; it is warmer.

lines.zh: 沙一扬，我就被埋了半截。
lines.en: Sand kicks up and half buries me.

lines.zh: 没有鳞，冷水直接贴上皮肤。
lines.en: No scales; cold water touches my skin directly.

lines.zh: 同伴在左边，还有一个在右边。
lines.en: One companion left, another on my right.

lines.zh: 我第一件事，是找块石头。
lines.en: My first act is to find a stone.

lines.zh: 深沟里又多了三条小鱼。
lines.en: Three more small fish in the deep trench.

lines.zh: 水烫起来，我的皮立刻缩了。
lines.en: The water heats and my skin shrinks at once.

lines.zh: 我掉出水面，风把我吹得发抖。
lines.en: I fall out of the water and the wind shakes me.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，我明明住在这里。
lines.en: Water pours in my mouth; I live here, after all.

lines.zh: 我被冲得贴在沟壁上，动不了。
lines.en: The blast pins me to the wall; I cannot move.

lines.zh: 箭落在我旁边，水都在震。
lines.en: An arrow lands beside me; the water shakes.

lines.zh: 一股怪味，我的身体轻得要飘走。
lines.en: A strange taste; my body feels light enough to drift.

lines.zh: 饿得发软，我连石头都吸不住。
lines.en: Weak with hunger, I cannot even grip the stone.

lines.zh: 雷进水里，我全身麻了一下。
lines.en: Lightning enters the water; my whole body goes numb.

lines.zh: 沟底空了，我一直往下掉。
lines.en: The trench floor is gone; I keep falling.
